label: Bible Study
prompt: Let every thing that hath _____ praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
note: The last verse of the whole Psalter — everything with lungs is invited to the choir.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have _____ each other.
verse: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
note: Mercy and truth meet, righteousness and peace kiss — the Bible's sweetest reunion of virtues.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a _____, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verse: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
note: After the ladder dream, Jacob turned his stone pillow into a pillar and anointed it — the place he named Beth-el.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine _____ have we given thee.
verse: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
note: David's prayer over the temple offering: we only give back what came from God's hand in the first place.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made _____ for the transgressors.
verse: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
note: Isaiah 53 ends in prayer: numbered with the transgressors, he 'made intercession' for them — as Jesus did on the cross (Luke 23:34).
